metadata.title: When Valorant Handed Me 2 Kills and My Brain Said ‘Wait, What Just Happened?’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just clutch this without trying?
Enemy probably went AFK or took a snack break.
Valorant logic strikes again, making no sense at all.
Click if your best plays are total accidents!

Tap if your best kills come out of pure confusion!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
